# Hello and welcome to my website!

::: {.justify}

I'm an applied economist with experience in empirical solutions to socio-economic issues. I am currently a Post-Doc at the Universidad Pública de Navarra candidate at [UPNA](https://www.unavarra.es/portada) (Public University of Navarre, Spain). I received my Ph.D. in 2024 from the [University of Navarre (UNAV)](https://www.unav.edu/)). 

My research interests lie broadly in the field of empirical Political Economy. To date, my focus is on: 
<ol>
  <li> The impact of different institutional arrangements on individual behaviors and social norms; </li>
  <li> Populism, including its causes, measurement, and effects on socio-economic institutions;</li>
  <li> Democratic backsliding and illiberalism within the public administration. </li>
</ol>

Besides my research, I'm a data analytics, visualization, and programming enthusiast.

This website contains part of my work as a researcher, teacher, and data scientist. You can find further materials at my [GitHub](https://github.com/acelico) page.

If you would like to get in touch, feel free to reach out via [email](mailto:and.celico@gmail.com)!

:::
